name: wontopos
description: Wontopos — long-term memory for AI agents. Identical recall in every language, ~100× lower LLM bill.
author: Wontopos

scripts.build: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.types.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json','{\"type\":\"commonjs\"}\n');fs.copyFileSync('dist/wontopos.d.ts','dist/cjs/wontopos.d.cts');fs.copyFileSync('dist/sleep.d.ts','dist/cjs/sleep.d.ts');fs.copyFileSync('dist/types.d.ts','dist/cjs/types.d.ts')"
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/client.test.mjs tests/rooms-work.test.mjs tests/router.test.mjs tests/sleep.test.mjs tests/sleep-attacks.test.mjs tests/hunt-transport.test.mjs tests/hunt-api.test.mjs tests/hunt-tools.test.mjs tests/hunt-router.test.mjs tests/hunt-sleep.test.mjs tests/hunt-packaging.test.mjs tests/hunt-knobs.test.mjs tests/hunt-parity.test.mjs tests/hunt-livefix.test.mjs tests/s2live.test.mjs tests/cov.test.mjs tests/cjs.test.cjs
